lines.zh: 我踩着炭渣走，脚底一点不烫。
lines.en: I walk over cinders and my soles feel nothing.

lines.zh: 小短腿迈得快，跟得上你。
lines.en: My short legs move fast enough to keep up.

lines.zh: 我翅膀懒得扇，还是用走的。
lines.en: I cannot be bothered to flap; I will walk.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫出一道灰痕。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, leaving a line in the ash.

lines.zh: 我跳上矮墙，走给你看。
lines.en: I hop onto the low wall and walk it for you.

lines.zh: 岩浆边上这条路，我熟。
lines.en: I know this path along the lava's edge.

lines.zh: 我一步一蹦，像踩着火苗。
lines.en: I bounce step by step, as if treading on flames.

lines.zh: 你走太快，我得小跑。
lines.en: You walk too fast; I have to trot.

lines.zh: 我从火堆里穿过去，抄近路。
lines.en: I cut through the bonfire for a shortcut.

lines.zh: 角那么小，还是会被门框刮到。
lines.en: My horns are tiny, yet the doorframe still scrapes them.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印，省力气。
lines.en: I step in your footprints to save effort.

lines.zh: 我走得大摇大摆，没人管我。
lines.en: I swagger along; nobody tells me otherwise.

lines.zh: 我坐在火塘里，这里最暖和。
lines.en: I sit inside the hearth; it is warmest there.

lines.zh: 我用指甲剔牙，剔出一点火星。
lines.en: I pick my teeth and a small spark comes loose.

lines.zh: 烟从我的鼻孔出来，很正常。
lines.en: Smoke comes out of my nostrils; that is normal.

lines.zh: 我在数火里的裂纹。
lines.en: I am counting the cracks inside the flame.

lines.zh: 翅膀收着，像两把破扇子。
lines.en: My wings fold up like two broken fans.

lines.zh: 我盯着蜡烛，等它烧短一截。
lines.en: I stare at the candle until it burns shorter.

lines.zh: 有只虫子飞过来，被我的热气赶走了。
lines.en: A bug flies near and my heat drives it off.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴卷起来当枕头。
lines.en: I curl my tail up and use it as a pillow.

lines.zh: 我在想铁匠那家伙现在在哪。
lines.en: I wonder where that smith fellow is now.

lines.zh: 这地面太干净，我想弄脏一点。
lines.en: This floor is too clean; I want to dirty it.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，冒出一缕烟。
lines.en: I burp and a wisp of smoke comes out.

lines.zh: 我的角在长，痒得很。
lines.en: My horns are growing, and they itch badly.

lines.zh: 我数自己的手指，还是五个。
lines.en: I count my fingers; still five.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听见自己在烧。
lines.en: In the quiet, I hear myself burning.

lines.zh: 炭火噼啪一声，我抬了下眼皮。
lines.en: The coals pop once; I lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 我用角蹭了蹭身后的石墙。
lines.en: I rub my horn against the stone wall behind me.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我仰头迎上去。
lines.en: You bend down and I raise my head to meet you.

lines.zh: 我眯眼，不是困，是在笑。
lines.en: I squint, not from sleep, but from grinning.

lines.zh: 让我握一下你的手，凉的好玩。
lines.en: Let me hold your hand; the coolness is fun.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转，等你说句话。
lines.en: I circle your feet, waiting for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你身上没有焦味，真奇怪。
lines.en: You do not smell of burning; how strange.

lines.zh: 别把我当宠物，我听得懂。
lines.en: Do not treat me as a pet; I understand you.

lines.zh: 我抬下巴，是让你看我角上的纹。
lines.en: I lift my chin so you see the marks on my horns.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我尾巴会摇。
lines.en: When you laugh, my tail wags.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，因为你会走开。
lines.en: I keep watching you because you tend to wander off.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就跳到你膝上。
lines.en: When you crouch, I hop onto your knee.

lines.zh: 我眨眼看你，眼睛里只有火。
lines.en: I blink at you; there is only fire in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你今天闻起来像铁，去哪了？
lines.en: You smell of iron today; where have you been?

lines.zh: 别看别人，看我。
lines.en: Do not look at others; look at me.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块炭留给你。
lines.en: I saved the best piece of coal for you.

lines.zh: 就这？我还没热身。
lines.en: Is that all? I have not even warmed up.

lines.zh: 痛归痛，我嘴上不认。
lines.en: Pain is pain, but my mouth will not admit it.

lines.zh: 打我的家伙，手应该烫伤了吧。
lines.en: Whoever hit me must have burned their hand.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块皮，还能长。
lines.en: I lost a patch of skin; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 别看我的伤，看它。
lines.en: Do not look at my wound; look at it.

lines.zh: 我腿软了一下，就一下。
lines.en: My legs gave a little, just once.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的角尖。
lines.en: That blow broke the tip of my horn.

lines.zh: 我退两步，喘口气再来。
lines.en: I fall back two steps, catch my breath, and return.

lines.zh: 别抱我，我身上有血。
lines.en: Do not pick me up; I am covered in blood.

lines.zh: 我还能咬，你让开。
lines.en: I can still bite; get out of the way.

lines.zh: 那块生肉，给我咬一口。
lines.en: That raw meat; let me have one bite.

lines.zh: 煤炭比面包香多了。
lines.en: Coal smells far better than bread.

lines.zh: 你手里那块燧石，我认得。
lines.en: I recognize that flint in your hand.

lines.zh: 火药？你确定要给我？
lines.en: Gunpowder? Are you sure you want to give me that?

lines.zh: 我闻到岩浆膏的味道了。
lines.en: I smell magma cream.

lines.zh: 把炭举高，我跳一下够。
lines.en: Hold the coal higher; I will jump for it.

lines.zh: 我只舔一口，不会烧掉。
lines.en: I will only lick it; it will not burn.

lines.zh: 这块熟肉太软，我想要生的。
lines.en: This cooked meat is too soft; I want it raw.

lines.zh: 你别拿火把逗我，我会抢。
lines.en: Do not tease me with a torch; I will snatch it.

lines.zh: 我咽口水，喉咙里冒烟。
lines.en: I swallow, and smoke rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 我个子小，你靴子差点压下来。
lines.en: I am small; your boot almost came down on me.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我弹开了，没事。
lines.en: We bump; I bounce off, unharmed.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，像撞墙。
lines.en: I run into your leg as if into a wall.

lines.zh: 别推我，我身上烫。
lines.en: Do not shove me; I am hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 我钻到你脚边，让一让。
lines.en: I slip to your feet; make some room.

lines.zh: 我的角顶到你的膝盖，抱歉。
lines.en: My horn pokes your knee; sorry.

lines.zh: 你把门撞开，我被拍在墙上。
lines.en: You push the door open and it slaps me into the wall.

lines.zh: 两个都不让，那就撞吧。
lines.en: Neither of us yields, so let us bump.

lines.zh: 我退后一步，尾巴被你踩了。
lines.en: I step back and you stand on my tail.

lines.zh: 别挤，火气上来了。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; my temper is rising.

lines.zh: 使魔不谈这个，我只认契约。
lines.en: Familiars do not speak of that; I know only the pact.

lines.zh: 我心里只有火和主人。
lines.en: My heart holds only fire and a master.

lines.zh: 别问我有没有伴，问就是没有。
lines.en: Do not ask whether I have a mate; the answer is no.

lines.zh: 我尾巴摇是高兴，不是别的。
lines.en: My tail wags from joy, nothing else.

lines.zh: 这一小块契约纸，比什么都重。
lines.en: This scrap of pact paper weighs more than anything.

lines.zh: 我活得不长，但够用。
lines.en: I will not live long, but long enough.

lines.zh: 火会灭，我不会先走。
lines.en: Fire may die, but I will not leave first.

lines.zh: 别把我配给谁，我不干。
lines.en: Do not pair me off with anyone; I refuse.

lines.zh: 我守着炉子，就算守一辈子。
lines.en: I will guard this furnace, even for a lifetime.

lines.zh: 有人靠近你，我会不高兴。
lines.en: When someone comes near you, I get unhappy.

lines.zh: 这块炭掉地上了，归我。
lines.en: This coal fell on the floor; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我把燧石衔回来给你。
lines.en: I carry the flint back to you.

lines.zh: 地上有块骨头，我收起来了。
lines.en: There was a bone on the ground; I stashed it.

lines.zh: 这枚铁粒烫手，我拿着正好。
lines.en: This iron nugget is hot; perfect for my hands.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的东西堆在门口。
lines.en: I pile the dropped things by the door.

lines.zh: 这块肉你还要吗？我咬过了。
lines.en: Do you still want this meat? I bit it.

lines.zh: 我捡了根木棍，可以烧。
lines.en: I picked up a stick; it will burn.

lines.zh: 你腰不好，地上的我来。
lines.en: Your back is bad; let me take the ground work.

lines.zh: 我把你的镐子拖回来了，很沉。
lines.en: I dragged your pickaxe back; it is heavy.

lines.zh: 这瓶药我舔过，难喝。
lines.en: I licked this potion; it is foul.

lines.zh: 有东西在门外，我先闻到了。
lines.en: Something is outside the door; I smelled it first.

lines.zh: 我后颈发烫，是要打架了。
lines.en: The back of my neck heats up; a fight is coming.

lines.zh: 它躲在暗处，可它忘了我会发光。
lines.en: It hides in the dark, forgetting that I glow.

lines.zh: 那群东西里，有一个拿着弓。
lines.en: Among that group, one carries a bow.

lines.zh: 我冲过去之前，先看你一眼。
lines.en: Before I charge, I glance at you once.

lines.zh: 它们踩坏了我的炭堆。
lines.en: They trampled my pile of coal.

lines.zh: 我听见骨头响，不是我的。
lines.en: I hear bones rattle, and they are not mine.

lines.zh: 这个我打得过，你别拦。
lines.en: I can take this one; do not stop me.

lines.zh: 它身上有股水腥味，讨厌。
lines.en: It smells of water and fish; I hate it.

lines.zh: 先动手的是它，记住了。
lines.en: It struck first; remember that.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开了，这是要飞过去。
lines.en: My wings are spread; I am about to fly at it.

lines.zh: 它比看起来矮，好办。
lines.en: It is shorter than it looks; easier.

lines.zh: 你往后退，我往前。
lines.en: You go back, I go forward.

lines.zh: 这一架我盼了很久。
lines.en: I have been waiting a long time for this fight.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，尾巴高高翘起。
lines.en: I crouch low with my tail raised high.

lines.zh: 它逃不了，我腿短可跑得急。
lines.en: It cannot flee; short legs, but I run hard.

lines.zh: 牙已经龇出来了，收不回去。
lines.en: My teeth are already out, and they will not retract.

lines.zh: 火在我喉咙里滚，等一个出口。
lines.en: Fire rolls in my throat, waiting for a way out.

lines.zh: 它以为小小的就不危险。
lines.en: It thinks small means harmless.

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，我要喷火。
lines.en: Do not stand right in front of me; I am about to breathe fire.

lines.zh: 我数到二就够了。
lines.en: Two is as high as I count.

lines.zh: 它退到墙角，我慢慢走过去。
lines.en: It backs into the corner; I walk over slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下是为我的炭堆。
lines.en: This is for my pile of coal.

lines.zh: 我脚底的火烧得更旺了。
lines.en: The fire under my feet burns brighter.

lines.zh: 它一转身，我就咬它的腿。
lines.en: When it turns, I will bite its leg.

lines.zh: 铁匠不在，这次我自己上。
lines.en: The smith is not here; this time I go alone.

lines.zh: 它喘得很急，快撑不住了。
lines.en: Its breathing is ragged; it will not last.

lines.zh: 眼睛别眨，我这一扑很快。
lines.en: Keep your eyes open; my pounce is quick.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，火从牙缝里漏出来。
lines.en: I crouch low, fire leaking between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脚踝，死不松口。
lines.en: I bite its ankle and refuse to let go.

lines.zh: 一爪子下去，它的皮开了。
lines.en: One swipe and its hide opens.

lines.zh: 我跳上它的背，抓它的脖子。
lines.en: I leap onto its back and claw its neck.

lines.zh: 火从嘴里喷出来，很近。
lines.en: Fire pours from my mouth at close range.

lines.zh: 它拍我，我滚了一圈又爬起来。
lines.en: It swats me; I roll once and rise again.

lines.zh: 我的角撞在它胸口，很硬。
lines.en: My horns strike its chest; it is hard.

lines.zh: 这一口咬偏了，我再补。
lines.en: That bite missed; I go again.

lines.zh: 我把它绊倒，尾巴一扫。
lines.en: I trip it with a sweep of my tail.

lines.zh: 它倒下时还瞪着我。
lines.en: It glares at me as it falls.

lines.zh: 打完我得吐口烟。
lines.en: After this I need to blow out some smoke.

lines.zh: 火圈一合，我就蹲在中间。
lines.en: The ring of fire closes and I crouch in the middle.

lines.zh: 我从灰里钻出来，先抖了抖。
lines.en: I climb out of the ash and shake myself first.

lines.zh: 这里的炉子归我管了。
lines.en: This furnace is mine to mind now.

lines.zh: 我刚来就闻到硫磺味。
lines.en: I smell sulfur the moment I arrive.

lines.zh: 契约纸上有你的名字，我认了。
lines.en: Your name is on the pact paper; I accept it.

lines.zh: 地上还有召唤留下的焦痕。
lines.en: Scorch marks from the summoning are still on the floor.

lines.zh: 我不大，但很能打。
lines.en: I am not big, but I fight well.

lines.zh: 第一次见你，你比我想的高。
lines.en: Meeting you for the first time, you are taller than I expected.

lines.zh: 我把自己的位置定在炉边。
lines.en: I claim my place by the furnace.

lines.zh: 别弯腰跟我说话，我不习惯。
lines.en: Do not bend down to speak to me; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 这屋子太亮，我眯一会儿眼。
lines.en: This room is too bright; I squint for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先落地，然后是我。
lines.en: My tail lands first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 你叫得挺急，出事了？
lines.en: You called in a hurry; is something wrong?

lines.zh: 我来了，火也有了。
lines.en: I am here, and so is the fire.

lines.zh: 火我是不怕的，烫还是烫。
lines.en: Fire does not frighten me, but hot is still hot.

lines.zh: 落地时我翻了两个跟头。
lines.en: I tumble twice when I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水一浇，我的火只剩一点。
lines.en: The water hits and my fire shrinks to a spark.

lines.zh: 炸得我飞起来，翅膀没用了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up; my wings are useless.

lines.zh: 背上中了箭，走一步扎一下。
lines.en: An arrow in my back stabs me with every step.

lines.zh: 这种咒，我身上起了一层灰。
lines.en: That spell leaves a layer of ash on me.

lines.zh: 我饿起来，比火还急。
lines.en: When I am hungry, I burn hotter than fire.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身炸毛。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我连灰都没剩。
lines.en: Falling into the void, not even ash remains.
